tasks.prompt: Work only in pilot-task/. Implement collapseMarker in pilot-task/src/collapse-marker.mjs. Collapse every repeated mk marker run to one marker while preserving surrounding text. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement ensurePrefix in pilot-task/src/ensure-prefix.mjs. Add the pre prefix exactly once and leave an already-prefixed token unchanged. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.
Work only in pilot-task/. Implement stripSuffix in pilot-task/src/strip-suffix.mjs. Remove the end suffix only when it occurs at the end of the token. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement parseToggle in pilot-task/src/parse-toggle.mjs. Parse the two documented toggle tokens and reject every unknown token with TypeError. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement reverseSegments in pilot-task/src/reverse-segments.mjs. Reverse every sep-delimited segment for any positive segment count. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement titleSegments in pilot-task/src/title-segments.mjs. Uppercase the first character of every sep-delimited non-empty segment. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement dedupeTokens in pilot-task/src/dedupe-tokens.mjs. Deduplicate sep-delimited tokens case-insensitively while preserving the first spelling and order. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement replaceMarkers in pilot-task/src/replace-markers.mjs. Replace every key marker with mask and preserve all other text. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement compressRuns in pilot-task/src/compress-runs.mjs. Compress only consecutive repeated characters and preserve later non-consecutive repeats. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement isPalindrome in pilot-task/src/palindrome.mjs. Return whether an alphanumeric token is a palindrome after lowercasing it. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.
Work only in pilot-task/. Implement commonPrefix in pilot-task/src/common-prefix.mjs. Return the complete longest common prefix of two string tokens. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.
Work only in pilot-task/. Implement rotateLeft in pilot-task/src/rotate-left.mjs. Rotate a non-empty string token left by exactly one character. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement validateIdentifier in pilot-task/src/validate-identifier.mjs. Accept safe identifier syntax but reject reserved object-meta identifiers. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement hasScope in pilot-task/src/scope-membership.mjs. Check exact membership in a sep-delimited scope list without substring authorization. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement redactSecrets in pilot-task/src/redact-secrets.mjs. Replace every sec marker with mask so no later occurrence survives. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement verifyEnvelope in pilot-task/src/verify-envelope.mjs. Accept a token only when both start and end boundary markers are present. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement runPipeline in pilot-task/src/run-pipeline.mjs. Apply every supplied synchronous stage in order and return the final value. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.
Work only in pilot-task/. Implement batchPairs in pilot-task/src/batch-pairs.mjs. Batch items in pairs and preserve a final one-item remainder batch. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

Work only in pilot-task/. Implement joinById in pilot-task/src/join-by-id.mjs. Join right-side values to left records by matching id regardless of right-side order. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.

hiddenAcceptance.command: cd pilot-task && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from'node:assert/strict';import{joinById}from'./src/join-by-id.mjs';const ida='hiddenidalpha';const idb='hiddenidbeta';const va='hiddenvaluealpha';const vb='hiddenvaluebeta';const out=joinById([{id:ida},{id:idb}],[{id:idb,value:vb},{id:ida,value:va}]);assert.equal(out.shift().value,va,'4a8dd7c1d2d457d7273166798dc692dd')"

tasks.prompt: Work only in pilot-task/. Implement latestById in pilot-task/src/latest-events.mjs. Return one event per id using the last event value while preserving first-id order. Run node --test pilot-task/test/public.test.mjs.
